frequency_question: How often do final rules published by immigration agencies match the specific target fee figure within a 10% margin, given that a fee adjustment regulation is finalized?
membership_rule: Includes all major USCIS/DHS fee schedule or petition fee adjustment final rules since 2009; excludes minor procedural updates or non-fee immigration rules.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 major DHS/USCIS fee rule cycles examined; all successfully established the targeted or proposed major fee amounts within the 10% threshold upon finalization.
known_gaps: Excludes minor fee adjustments for niche application types.
skeleton: Named historical fee schedule final rules where the proposed major fee figures either survived to the final rule within the 10% margin or were modified
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 named major fee final rules
validity_reason: Tied to the standard regulatory drafting and publication predictability under the Administrative Procedure Act across executive administrations.
